_comment: The section-landing tile for elevation mocks. Beyond the physical-height defect (高程模擬, 'survey-elevation simulation'), the description leaf had collapsed to the same three characters as the title, so the tile's explanatory subtitle silently repeated its own heading and told the operator nothing about what the page contains. Restored as a real translation of the English description, with 提升權限 for elevation. AGENT DRAFTS -- native review still required.
